-- Load Rayfield Library
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

-- Runs a block safely; if it errors, shows the error on screen instead of silently killing the script
local function try(label, fn)
	local ok, err = pcall(fn)
	if not ok then
		warn("[" .. label .. "] " .. tostring(err))
		pcall(function()
			Rayfield:Notify({ Title = "Error: " .. label, Content = tostring(err), Duration = 10 })
		end)
	end
	return ok
end

local function notify(title, content)
	pcall(function()
		Rayfield:Notify({ Title = title, Content = content, Duration = 4 })
	end)
end

-- Safe remote lookup (never errors; warns + notifies if something is missing)
local function find(root, path)
	local cur = root
	for _, name in ipairs(string.split(path, "/")) do
		cur = cur and cur:FindFirstChild(name)
	end
	return cur
end

local Knit = find(ReplicatedStorage, "Packages/_Index/acecateer_knit@1.7.2/knit/Services")

local function remote(path)
	local r = Knit and find(Knit, path)
	if not r then table.insert(Missing, path) end
	return r
end

-- Rarity FALLBACK (a guess based on item number). If the game stores a real rarity

	{ "Common",    1,  10 },
	{ "Uncommon", 11,  25 },
	{ "Rare",     26,  40 },
	{ "Epic",     41,  55 },
	{ "Legendary",56,  70 },

-- Helpers
local function normalize(name)
	name = tostring(name):lower():gsub("^%s*%d+_", ""):gsub("[^%a]", "")
	return name
end

local function cleanLootName(rawName)
	local cleaned = rawName:gsub("^%s*%d+_", ""):gsub("_", " ")
	return cleaned:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
end

local ItemsByKey = {}        -- normalized -> {key, clean, num}
local CleanToKey = {}
local CleanLootOptions = {}

for _, raw in ipairs(RawLootList) do
	local clean = cleanLootName(raw)
	local key = normalize(raw)
	ItemsByKey[key] = { key = key, clean = clean, num = tonumber(raw:match("^%s*(%d+)")) or 0 }
	CleanToKey[clean] = key
	table.insert(CleanLootOptions, clean)
end

SelectedItems[normalize("Button")] = true

-- Cache: instance name -> item info (or false). Avoids re-running string ops on every part each scan.
local InfoByName = {}
local function itemInfo(name)
	local info = InfoByName[name]
	if info == nil then
		info = ItemsByKey[normalize(name)] or false
		InfoByName[name] = info
	end
	return info or nil
end

local function tierFromNumber(n)
	for _, t in ipairs(RarityTiers) do
		if n >= t[2] and n <= t[3] then return t[1] end
	end
	return "Unknown"
end

local function readRarity(inst)
	local a = inst:GetAttribute("Rarity") or inst:GetAttribute("rarity")
	if a ~= nil then return tostring(a) end
	local v = inst:FindFirstChild("Rarity")
	if v and v:IsA("ValueBase") then return tostring(v.Value) end
	return nil
end

-- Returns lowercase rarity, source ("game" or "guess")
local function getRarity(inst, info)
	local cur = inst
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		if not cur or cur == Workspace then break end
		local r = readRarity(cur)
		if r then return r:lower(), "game" end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return tierFromNumber(info.num):lower(), "guess"
end

local function isPlayerStuff(inst)
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p.Character and inst:IsDescendantOf(p.Character) then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function getHRP()
	local c = LocalPlayer.Character
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

-- Tween (with hard snap at the end so you always arrive)
local function sellingNow() return IsSelling end

local function tweenToCFrame(targetCFrame, duration, abortIf)
	local hrp = getHRP()
	if not hrp then return end
	duration = duration or TravelSpeed

	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	local tween = TweenService:Create(hrp, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = targetCFrame })
	tween:Play()
	task.wait(duration + 0.05)
	tween:Cancel()

	-- something else (selling) took over the character; don't snap it back to this target
	if abortIf and abortIf() then return end

	if hrp.Parent then
		hrp.CFrame = targetCFrame
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
end

-- Sell
local function getSellTarget()
	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if (obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("Model")) and (obj.Name:lower():find("sell") or obj.Name:lower():find("base")) then
			local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if part then return part end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function executeSell()
	if IsSelling then return end
	IsSelling = true

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local hrp = getHRP()
		if not hrp then return end

		local originalCFrame = hrp.CFrame
		local sellPart = getSellTarget()

		if sellPart then
			tweenToCFrame(sellPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), TravelSpeed)
			task.wait(0.1)

			local sellPrompt = sellPart.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or sellPart:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
			if sellPrompt then fireproximityprompt(sellPrompt) end

			local touch = sellPart:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TouchTransmitter", true)
			if touch then
				firetouchinterest(hrp, sellPart, 0)
				task.wait(0.05)
				firetouchinterest(hrp, sellPart, 1)
			end
		end

		if UnequipLootRF then UnequipLootRF:InvokeServer() end
		if SellAllRF then SellAllRF:InvokeServer() end
		if ResetBackpackRF then ResetBackpackRF:InvokeServer() end

		task.wait(0.1)
		if hrp and hrp.Parent then
			tweenToCFrame(originalCFrame, TravelSpeed)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[Sell error]", err) end

	IsSelling = false
end

-- Find the nearest world item that passes the item whitelist OR the rarity whitelist
local function isWanted(inst, info)
	if SelectedItems[info.key] then return true end
	if next(SelectedRarities) then
		local rarity = getRarity(inst, info)
		if SelectedRarities[rarity] then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function findNearestWanted(fromPos)
	local bestPart, bestRoot, bestDist = nil, nil, math.huge
	local now = tick()

	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			local info = itemInfo(obj.Name)
			if info and isWanted(obj, info) and not isPlayerStuff(obj)
				and not (RecentlyTried[obj] and now - RecentlyTried[obj] < 1.5) then

				local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
				local prompt = part and (obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true))
				if part and prompt then
					local d = (part.Position - fromPos).Magnitude
					if d < bestDist then
						bestPart, bestRoot, bestDist = part, obj, d
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return bestPart, bestRoot
end

local function collectOne()
	if IsSelling or PredictorBusy or not AutoCollectEnabled then return end

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local hrp = getHRP()
		if not hrp then return end

		local part, root = findNearestWanted(hrp.Position)
		if not part then return end

		RecentlyTried[root] = tick()
		local startCFrame = hrp.CFrame

		tweenToCFrame(part.CFrame, TravelSpeed, sellingNow)
		task.wait(0.05)

		if not IsSelling then
			local prompt = root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
			if prompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
			firetouchinterest(hrp, part, 0)
			firetouchinterest(hrp, part, 1)
			task.wait(0.05)
		end

		if ReturnToStart and not IsSelling then
			tweenToCFrame(startCFrame, TravelSpeed, sellingNow)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[Collect error]", err) end
end

-- Auto sell listener
if NotificationRE then
	NotificationRE.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
		if AutoSellWhenFullEnabled then executeSell() end
	end)
end

-- Auto buy: buys the strongest affordable cutter in the shop
local FailedBuys = {}

local function buyBestAvailableCutter()
	if not (GetShopStateRF and BuyCutterRF) then return end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local state = GetShopStateRF:InvokeServer()
		if type(state) ~= "table" or type(state.CuttersData) ~= "table" then return end

		local balance = tonumber(state.Balance) or 0
		local owned = state.OwnedCutters or {}
		local data = state.CuttersData

		-- strongest regular cutter already owned
		local bestOwnedMult = 0
		for name, isOwned in pairs(owned) do
			local info = data[name]
			if isOwned and info and info.Type == "Default" and (info.DamageMult or 0) > bestOwnedMult then
				bestOwnedMult = info.DamageMult
			end
		end

		-- buyable, affordable, and better than what we have
		local candidates = {}
		for name, info in pairs(data) do
			if not owned[name]
				and info.Type == "Default"
				and not info.EventOnly and not info.GamePassOnly and not info.HiddenUntilOwned
				and (info.Price or 0) > 0 and info.Price <= balance
				and (info.DamageMult or 0) > bestOwnedMult
				and not (FailedBuys[name] and tick() - FailedBuys[name] < 30) then
				table.insert(candidates, { name = name, mult = info.DamageMult })
			end
		end
		table.sort(candidates, function(a, b) return a.mult > b.mult end)

		-- don't swap away from an "OP" cutter (those give a bonus over your best cutter)
		local currentInfo = data[state.CurrentCutter]
		local keepCurrent = currentInfo and currentInfo.BestOwnedDamageBonus ~= nil

		for _, c in ipairs(candidates) do
			BuyCutterRF:InvokeServer(c.name)

			-- verify the purchase by re-reading the shop
			local newState = GetShopStateRF:InvokeServer()
			local bought = type(newState) == "table" and newState.OwnedCutters and newState.OwnedCutters[c.name]

			if bought then
				if not keepCurrent and EquipCutterRF then EquipCutterRF:InvokeServer(c.name) end
				break
			else
				FailedBuys[c.name] = tick() -- e.g. world not unlocked yet; retry later
			end
		end
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[AutoBuy error]", err) end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------
-- ITEM PREDICTOR (list of spawned items, most expensive first)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------
local PicturesOn = false
local ListParagraph
local PanelGui, PanelRows, PanelFrame, PanelEmpty
local PicturesToggle
local PanelExpanded = true
local PanelCount = 0
local PanelQueue = {}          -- items waiting to be collected
local CurrentTarget = nil      -- item being collected right now
local closePanel, enqueueItem
local LastScan = {}
local MAX_LIST = 10
local MAX_PICS = 5

-- Most expensive item overall (highest item number)
local TopItem
for _, info in pairs(ItemsByKey) do
	if not TopItem or info.num > TopItem.num then TopItem = info end
end

-- Uses a price stored on the item if the game has one, otherwise falls back to item number
local ValueNames = { "Price", "Value", "SellPrice", "SellValue", "Worth", "Cost", "Coins" }
local function readGameValue(inst)
	local cur = inst
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		if not cur or cur == Workspace then break end
		for _, n in ipairs(ValueNames) do
			local a = cur:GetAttribute(n)
			if type(a) == "number" then return a end
			local v = cur:FindFirstChild(n)
			if v and v:IsA("ValueBase") and type(v.Value) == "number" then return v.Value end
		end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

-- Spawned items sorted most expensive first, plus what they were ranked by
local function scanItems()
	local found, allGame = {}, true

	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			local info = itemInfo(obj.Name)
			if info and not isPlayerStuff(obj) then
				local parentInfo = obj.Parent and itemInfo(obj.Parent.Name)
				if not (parentInfo and parentInfo.key == info.key) then
					local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
					local prompt = part and (obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true))
					if part and prompt then
						local gv = readGameValue(obj)
						if gv == nil then allGame = false end
						table.insert(found, { root = obj, part = part, info = info, gameValue = gv })
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, f in ipairs(found) do
		f.value = (allGame and f.gameValue) or f.info.num
	end
	table.sort(found, function(a, b) return a.value > b.value end)

	return found, (allGame and #found > 0) and "game price" or "item number"
end

local function listText(found)
	if #found == 0 then return "No items spawned right now." end
	local hrp = getHRP()
	local lines = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(#found, MAX_LIST) do
		local f = found[i]
		local dist = hrp and math.floor((f.part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude) or 0
		table.insert(lines, i .. ". " .. f.info.clean .. " (#" .. f.info.num .. ") - " .. dist .. " studs")
	end
	if #found > MAX_LIST then
		table.insert(lines, "+" .. (#found - MAX_LIST) .. " more")
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

-- 3D picture of an item inside a ViewportFrame
local function setThumb(vp, root)
	vp:ClearAllChildren()
	pcall(function()
		local clone = root:Clone()
		if not clone then return end
		for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then d:Destroy() end
		end
		clone.Parent = vp

		local cf, size
		if clone:IsA("Model") then
			cf, size = clone:GetBoundingBox()
		else
			cf, size = clone.CFrame, clone.Size
		end

		local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
		cam.Parent = vp
		vp.CurrentCamera = cam
		local dist = math.max(size.Magnitude, 1) * 1.1
		cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + Vector3.new(1, 0.7, 1).Unit * dist, cf.Position)
	end)
end

-- Floating item panel: flat, black, square edges
local Theme = {
	Bg = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
	Line = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45),
	Border = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70),
	Thumb = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 14),
	Text = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	Muted = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
	Hover = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35),
	Red = Color3.fromRGB(200, 45, 45),     -- idle
	Green = Color3.fromRGB(45, 175, 75),   -- collecting
	Blue = Color3.fromRGB(50, 110, 220),   -- waiting
}
local PANEL_W = 280
local HEADER_H = 30
local ROW_H = 56

-- Drag by the header (mouse and touch)
local function makeDraggable(handle, target)
	local dragging, dragStart, startPos

	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = target.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			target.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		end
	end)
end

local function panelHeight(n)
	if not PanelExpanded then return HEADER_H end
	if n == 0 then return HEADER_H + 30 end
	return HEADER_H + n * ROW_H
end

local function applyPanelSize(n)
	PanelCount = n
	if PanelFrame then
		PanelFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, panelHeight(n))
	end
end

local function inQueue(root)
	for _, q in ipairs(PanelQueue) do
		if q.root == root then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function stateColor(root)
	if CurrentTarget == root then return Theme.Green end
	if inQueue(root) then return Theme.Blue end
	return Theme.Red
end

local function headerButton(parent, text, rightOffset)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	b.Position = UDim2.new(1, -rightOffset, 0.5, 0)
	b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 22)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Bg
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.AutoButtonColor = false
	b.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	b.Text = text
	b.TextSize = 18
	b.TextColor3 = Theme.Muted
	b.Parent = parent

	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Hover
		b.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
	end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Bg
		b.TextColor3 = Theme.Muted
	end)
	return b
end

local function buildPanel()
	if PanelGui then return end

	gui.Name = "ItemPredictorPanel"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	pcall(function()
		gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
	end)

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Panel"
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -PANEL_W - 12, 0, 90)
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, panelHeight(0))
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Bg
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 1
	frame.BorderColor3 = Theme.Border
	frame.ClipsDescendants = true
	frame.Parent = gui

	-- Header
	local header = Instance.new("Frame")
	header.Name = "Header"
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, HEADER_H)
	header.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Bg
	header.BorderSizePixel = 0

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 1, 0)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	title.Text = "Item Predictor"
	title.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
	title.TextSize = 16
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = header

	local minBtn = headerButton(header, "-", 34)
	local closeBtn = headerButton(header, "X", 6)

	local headerLine = Instance.new("Frame")
	headerLine.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)

	if PredictorBusy then return end

	task.spawn(function()
		local hrp0 = getHRP()
		local startCFrame = hrp0 and hrp0.CFrame

		while #PanelQueue > 0 do
			while IsSelling do task.wait(0.2) end

			local q = table.remove(PanelQueue, 1)
			CurrentTarget = q.root
			updatePanel(LastScan)

			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				local hrp = getHRP()
				if not hrp then return end
				if not (q.root.Parent and q.part.Parent) then return end -- already gone

				tweenToCFrame(q.part.CFrame, TravelSpeed, sellingNow)
				task.wait(0.05)

scripts.script:
local gu = getupvalue or debug.getupvalue
local cloneref = cloneref or function(o) return o end
local ZERO = Vector3.new()

local RS = cloneref(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"))
local RunService = cloneref(game:GetService("RunService"))
local lp = cloneref(game:GetService("Players")).LocalPlayer

local mods = getloadedmodules()
local cam
for i = 1, #mods do
    local ok, r = pcall(require, mods[i])
    if ok and type(r) == "table" and type(r.setWeaponRecoil) == "function"
       and type(r.weaponKick) == "function" then cam = r; break end
end
if not cam then return warn("hmmmmmm") end

local function hook(spring, method)
    local orig = type(spring) == "table" and spring[method]
    if type(orig) == "function" then
        spring[method] = function(self, _, ...) return orig(self, ZERO, ...) end
    end
end

pcall(function()
    hook(gu(cam.setWeaponRecoil, 1), "setGoal")
    for u = 1, 2 do
        local sp = gu(cam.weaponKick, u)
        hook(sp, "setPosition"); hook(sp, "impulse"); hook(sp, "setGoal")
    end
end)

pcall(function()
    require(RS.Interface.Screens.Gameplay.Middle.Crosshair.Settings)["Follow Recoil"] = false

    local frame = lp.PlayerGui.MainGui.Gameplay.Middle.Crosshair
    local centre = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    RunService:BindToRenderStep("nr_pin", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
        if frame.Position ~= centre then
            frame.Position = centre
        end
    end)
end)
